documented_behavior.raw_score: log mean eta; response prediction is exp(eta)
documented_behavior.fit_interface: LGBMRegressor.fit accepts sample_weight; no eval_set or early stopping needed

root_math: Poisson deviance D is homogeneous: n*D(y/n,mu/n)=D(y,mu), for n>0,y>=0,mu>0 including y=0. Thus n*mean1_decay180 weights preserve the CF-scale quasi-loss under normalization. This is not a claim that solar energy is integer-count data.
limits: Documentation URLs point to moving main; no commit pin inferred. Experiment must independently pin installed LightGBM4.7.0 DLL SHA256 and actual native model parameters. No performance evidence from documentation.
